name: Separation-Margin Minor and Product Laws
statement: Cube symmetries and constant-coordinate extensions preserve $\mu$. Every nonempty pc-minor $D$ of $C$ satisfies $\mu(D)\ge\mu(C)$, and $\mu(C\times D)=\min\{\mu(C),\mu(D)\}$.
proof: Restriction and renormalization transport certificates through projections and conditionings. Product minimal missing patterns lie in one factor, so factor certificates concatenate; factor projections prove the reverse bound.
